title: What the Net Cannot See
logline: Night after night, a small lagoon-fishing crew works by lamplight where most of what reaches them never becomes a catch, a flicker at the edge of sight, a sound not quite placed, and only a few signals ever become a decision to strike.

object.note: Object 5 (identity not chosen) may appear subtly, for example among Chathura's things while he travels, waits or watches, only where it sits naturally in a real moment. Never staged, never the subject.

thread_in.thread: The salt pans' daylight turns to a lagoon at night, where most of what reaches the crew, a flicker, a splash, never becomes a decision.

thread_out.thread: From signals at the edge of sight in the dark to the half-light of a pre-dawn flower market, where colour is seen before any flower is named.

requirements: A working lagoon, estuary or shallow reef fished at night
A crew willing to be filmed through long, low-light hours
Safe water access for a small camera crew at night

suggestions.name: Batticaloa Lagoon
suggestions.why: A well-known lagoon with an active night-fishing tradition.
suggestions.access_notes: Night filming on water requires careful safety planning.
